text: NEW FORM OF TERROR ON RIVER

label: text
text:
Pukkal, Kongmoon, May 16.
An offshoot of the 'picket, evil' has now been developed to an extent by which it has become a real terror. Men are going about with strike-pickets' underarms and holding up vessels to robbery. Seven boats have been molested so far. The passengers have suffered heavy losses. Unlike the "professional" pirates, these outlaws do not take the passengers into captivity (for purposes of ransom).

label: text
text: Up-country merchants are forming small, transport companies, with boats running between Macao and the following ports: Chiu Lin, Ngol Hoi, Muk Chow, etc.

label: text
text: Over 2,000 (Canton, soldiers) who were sent from Shihiheng to suppress the plures (do Ho Tong) are staying and Packknid. They left for Canton at midnight last night. I learn that they are being sent to the Hunan border to join the Northern Expedition.

label: text
text: On heaving of the arrival of the troops, pieates in this yelnity immediately mobilised at Laki Ngok (opposite Kongmoon) and prepared to resist.

label: text
text: Leung She, the notorious pirate of the Ku-Tau Shen, has been making a clean sweep in the south-western part of the Canton River delta, attacking villages and river truille every day.

label: text
text: When the mobilisation order went out, the Kongmoon tow-boat "Lee Yuen" immediately left this port for Canton for fear of being commandeened for treop transport. Passengers had to be transferred to Kongmoon by rail, or by boats.

label: text
text: Apparently a new peace move is being made in Morocco. Official quarters in Paris confirm a report that a parent member of the Red Cross mission in Riff has arrived in Fez with a letter from Abd el Krim for M. Steeg, the French Resident. text: BITTER FIGHT COMING IN U.S. SENATE

label: text
text: The House of Representatives Ways and Means Committee has approved of the French war debt settlement. The Chairman expects the Bill to pass the House with little opposition, but that there will be a long and bitter fight in the Senate.

label: text
text: A record haul of chandu was made by a search party from the Government Monopolies on board the "Tilamba" on the vessel's arrival at Penang from China ports via Singapore.

label: text
text: Under some matting in the match store was found approximately 6,000 tahils of non-Government chandu, valued at about $54,000.

label: text
text: A Cantonese passenger and a cook were arrested in connection with the seizure.

label: text
text: A further search of the vessel was made and an additional 259 tablishes, valued at $2,381, was found.

label: text
text:
This is the largest seizure of non-Government chandu ever made in Penang.
GERMANY

label: text
text: The German Communist Party and the extreme Nationalist organisation, the Stahlhelm or "Steel Helmets", held reviews of their respective "Armies" yesterday—the former in Berlin and the latter in Duesseldorf.

label: text
text: The Communists are estimated to have numbered 30,000 and the Stahlhelmites 50,000.

label: text
text: Large forces of police, including mounted constables, were present, but the proceedings were orderly.

label: text
text: The Communist review was held in a large park in Berlin in the presence of thousands of curious spectators. The "army" was arrayed in semi-military uniform and performed military evolutions with commendable celebrity, whilst the bands played revolutionary airs. Many speeches were made denouncing anything and everybody, including the British Trade Union leaders' "betrayal" of the workers. The assembly then dispersed—with bands playing and banbers flying—singing songs including the Communists' latest favourite: "Mother, the policeman killed your child."

label: text
text: Two police aeroplanes circled overhead during the proceedings.

label: text
text: While removing Communist posters from the walls of the Consulate on May 23 the British Consulate Swatow was assaulted by seven pickets.

label: text
text: The Consul defended himself with a stick and retired into the compound. The pickets, observing that other foreigners were there, did not enter.

label: text
text: The Consul subsequently summoned an armed guard from the British gunboat in the harbour and informed the Chinese Foreign Commissioner that the guard would remain until he received an official apology and an assurance that no more posters would be posted on the walls of the Consulate.

label: text
text: The Consul also demanded that the offenders should be punished and pickets prohibited from landing on that side of the harbour.

label: text
text: The Congul is not seriously injured.

label: text
text: There are no fewer than 650,000 waifs and strays in Russia, many of them living under ap-palling conditions, according to revelations at a sitting of the Council of the People's Commis-sars presided over by M. Rykoff and reported in the Izvestia.

label: text
text: It was stated that Government institutions are already housing 350,000 and the Council decided to offer inducements to other institutions and to artisans willing to take homeless children as apprentices.

label: text
text: The Pravda reports that in the Tula district horrible conditions are experienced by children in some Government homes. The children are terrorised into silence as regards the brutal treatment and immorality practised by the managers of these establishments.

text: The recapture of Bluefields by the Government troops is regarded as marking the end of the revolution in Nicaragua.

label: text
text: The Union Jack is flying everywhere, outside shops, on motorcars, and in people's buttonholes. Some of the leading Labour Ministers have threatened to resign if the measure is proceeded with.

label: text
text: There is likelihood of Coll Hertzog, postponing the further stages of the Bill in view of the intensity of feeling.

label: text
text: Twenty-eight of the Constabulary at San Fernando, Pampagna, are involved in the killing of civilians. The Municipal Police disarmed them and lodged them in jail on a charge of murder.

label: text
text: A detachment of twenty constabulary from Malolos have been sent to San Fernando to preserve order.

label: text
text: It appears that two native officers commanding the detachment involved in the riot were absent, attending dances in other towns when the shooting began.

label: text
text: With a tremendous roar, which was heard 20 miles away, Mount Tokachi, a dormant volcano. in Hokkaido, suddenly erupted yesterday afternoon.

label: text
text: According to despatches from Sapporo it is reported that 60 houses were buried in lava and that 120 persons are missing mainly miners, inside the local sulphur mine.

label: text
text: The inhabitants of Miye a town at the base of the volicano, are fleeing in confusion as the place is seriously endangered, whilst the train service has been suspended.

label: text
text: This issue is part of a loan of 72,000,000 guilders, of which 24,000,000 guilders was issued in January.

label: text
text: It is with regret that we have to record the death, which took place at Home on May 22, of Mr. Evelyn Edward de Wiveleslie Abney, formerly manager of the Hongkong Branch of Thos. Cook and Son.

label: text
text: Mr. Abney, who had spent many years in the Far East, was formerly with the Peninsular and Oriental, Steamship Navigation Company and had been stationed at Manila where he was married. It was in 1911 that he entered the service of Thos. Cook, and Son and when he left in 1924 he was Manager of the Hongkong branch. Mr. Abney, acting on medical, advice, did not return to Hongkong but became associated with the Far Eastern Department of Cooks at Pall Mall.

label: text
text: The news of his death came as a great shock to his many friends in Hongkong. Much sympathy will be felt for the 'widow' and young daughter of the deceased.
